---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea for SonicBlueprint
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

## Problem
What can't you (or a first-time musician) currently do? What is awkward about it today?

## Proposal
What should change, in plain words? (Mockups or sketches welcome.)

## Scope
- Area: (chords / drums / bass / melody / instruments / arrangement / playback / export / projects / other)
- Does this need new presets (data only), UI changes, or audio-engine changes?

## Notes
- New presets must not reference existing commercial songs or artists.
- Features must not promise AI generation or guarantee protection from third-party similarity detection.
